channel.title: Legend Mod — Changelog
channel.description: Latest updates and new features for Legend Mod, the best agar.io extension.

item.title: v3.569 — Death Recap, Kill Feed & Mass-Loss Alert
item.description: Death recap on the Game Over card shows the last 20 seconds as 3-6 steps: mass, splits, viruses, merges, quick mass losses, and who ate you. Kill feed displays your eats and deaths live. Mass-loss alert with configurable threshold.

item.title: v3.568 — Adaptive Performance & Network Diagnostics
item.description: Adaptive performance auto-optimizes when FPS drops below target. Performance diagnostics window with frame time graph, p50/p95/p99 stats. Network quality history tracks ping, jitter and disconnects across sessions.

item.title: v3.567 — Command Centre, Notifications & Sound Mixer
item.description: Ctrl+K Command Centre to search all 220+ settings, hotkeys and commands. Notification centre keeps last 200 toasts with filters. Sound mixer with per-channel volumes and audio ducking.

item.title: v3.566 — HUD Helpers, Settings Profiles & Analytics
item.description: Movement direction arrow, merge countdown, enemy mass ratio, screen-edge arrows to teammates and threats. Named settings profiles with auto-switching per server type. Analytics dashboard with heatmaps and coaching.

item.title: v3.565 — Gamepad Customization & Badges
item.description: Full gamepad button mapping — any pad button can run any hotkey command. Movement range and curve tuning. 18 achievement badges with tiers from your account stats.

item.title: v3.564 — Mobile Touch Direction & Game Over Share
item.description: Direction on touch option: the cell moves toward where your finger touches. Game Over Share button with mass and time alive. Hotkey to reconnect to the previous server.
